_comment: CANDIDATES only, not loaded by the recipe engine and not merged into recipes/recipes.json. Written when blueprints/ was deleted (see engine-doctrine/MISTAKES.md and the retire-blueprints inventory) to carry forward the 18 sourced beat factories as recipe-shaped notes for whoever migrates one. Each entry needs its `t` re-measured against the real clip before it can move into recipes/recipes.json: the blueprint files cited their source in prose, and none of the prose timestamps were verified against a frame the way recipes/README.md requires.

typed-erase-enter.blurb: a line types itself in at a fixed rate, holds, then un-types at roughly twice the type rate; it never fades, the caret is the only decoration

sources.note: the exemplar, cited in prose only, no shot or timestamp given

untypeRateMultiple.note: un-type speed as a multiple of the type speed

morph-to-next-seam.blurb: one object becomes the next: on a single progress variable, width/height shrink, corner radius grows from square to round on a cubic curve, and the label opacity falls away early on a squared term

sources.note: the exemplar, cited in prose only, no shot or timestamp given

prop-sentence-spine.blurb: a claim's nouns are real objects (word, photo, chip, captured UI, word) flowed as one wrapping reading line; every item's entrance staggers by its place in the sentence, all items leave together

sources.note: 9 layers land inside 0.42s at a rolling 0.06-0.08s step

stagger.note: measured rolling step, 0.06-0.08s across the shot

slot-swap-spine.blurb: three fixed slots never move while their contents turn over N passes on one repeated rhythm; the last slot changes what KIND of thing it holds each pass so the row reads as being refilled, not as a table

recorded-pan-camera.blurb: a surface wider than the frame drifts into place then pans on an irregular multi-key linear track, riders welded to the same track by copying its deltas and time-shifting by the rider's own start

rhythm.note: the irregular key spacing that makes the interior read as scrolled, not glided

echo-ring-enter.blurb: a stroked ring replays another layer's path one beat late, growing and fading as it goes, supplying motion during a slow morph without competing with the subject for attention

sources.note: formats/scene/higgsfield-recreation.json beat 4, the generate button becoming a dot

envelope.note: [fraction of life, fraction of growth, opacity], normalised off the exemplar's ring

scroll-story-camera.blurb: a surface taller than the frame scrolls under a static tilt while the frame stays put; stops are absolute section offsets, every scroll shares one ease, held at each stop before the next begins

sources.note: generalised from the exemplar; engine-doctrine/CRAFT/KEYED-MOTION.md carries the measurements

word-blast-punct.blurb: one word or mark arrives already too big, settles into its reading on a decelerating curve, creeps very slightly so a held frame never freezes, then leaves by growing through the frame rather than fading

arriveScaleMark.note: a wide mark takes less amplitude than a word

blur-resolve-enter.blurb: type arrives smeared with motion blur and snaps into focus on the blur channel alone; nothing slides, fades or scales

dialogue-accumulate-spine.blurb: sans/serif word pairs accumulate one after another on a held frame, a small dot as the joint between each pair; the type never moves, only the ground blooms under a late arriving payoff line

container-fill-spine.blurb: a fixed panel frame never moves while chips fill it in one at a time; the frame is the constant, the count is the variable

card-fan-enter.blurb: N cards arrive from one side and fan open in perspective around a fixed anchor, each a touch later and a touch more rotated than its neighbour

list-build-rows-spine.blurb: a vertical list grows one row at a time under a fixed left rule; the list never resets what already landed

chip-converge-enter.blurb: a ring of chips scatters in from every side and then converges onto one point, the opposite choreography to a cascade

cell-mosaic-spine.blurb: a grid of mixed cells travels as ONE object while every cell keeps its own content, so words and pictures cross the cell boundaries together instead of reading as separate slides

sources.note: the film's busiest shot, motion 5.77, a dark grid sliding under dotted rules

word-wipe-seam.blurb: one word, far larger than the canvas, crosses the whole frame motion-blurred on an accelerating curve; its passage IS the transition, and what it reveals lands the instant it clears

sources.note: one word ~8x the frame's own type, the loudest frame in that film

slots.reveal: layer id revealed as the word clears

scale.note: on top of the type-size cap, for the ~8x frame-fill look

wordmark-assemble-enter.blurb: the brand mark settles from scattered letters while small tiles drift slowly at a different depth behind it, so the brand assembles rather than simply appearing

sources.note: the last shot: cards tumbling, tiles drifting, a wordmark scrambling into place, ending on the mark alone

viewport-trio-spine.blurb: the same subject shown at three sizes at once, staggered slightly on entrance, the "it is really finished" payoff shot

sources.note: the film's loudest peak, the finished site in three viewports simultaneously

slots.subject: one image, reused at each size
